column1: # Week 10, 2026 — venue of every fixture, transcribed from the official game centre
# Source: each fixture's own NFL.com Game Center page, "Game Info" block, read on 2026-11-15 UTC.
# Field names: the page prints exactly two fields, "Location" and "Stadium".
# The values below are those two fields, character for character (the page prints them in capitals).
# Nothing is inferred: a fixture whose page did not print a field would leave it blank and be flagged.
# The "note" column records ONLY what the official page itself printed next to the fixture
# (an international-game label or the network); it is not a derived field.
# Cross-check performed: the fixture list, kickoff times and home/away order agree with
# data/nfl/schedule_week10.tsv (transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official weekly schedule page).
# Score and status columns are NOT taken from here; they stay with the verified results feed.
# BYES printed by the official schedule page for Week 10: CHI, DEN, PHI, TB (4 clubs, 14 fixtures = 32 clubs).
